name: gizza-ai/url-encode
summary: Percent-encode or decode text and URLs.

tool.description: Percent-encode or percent-decode text and URLs. Use mode='encode' (default) to make text URL-safe or mode='decode' to reverse it. When encoding, target='component' (default) escapes everything for a single query value or path segment (e.g. 'São Paulo' -> 'S%C3%A3o%20Paulo'); target='uri' encodes a whole URL while preserving its delimiters (: / ? # & = etc.); target='form' is application/x-www-form-urlencoded, where a space becomes '+' (and decodes back). Set per_line=true to convert each line of a batch list independently. Set repeat>1 (up to 16) to un-nest multiply-encoded input when decoding, or to double-encode.

text.description: The text or URL to encode or decode.

target.description: Encoding style. 'component' (default) escapes reserved chars for a single query value or path segment; 'uri' preserves URL delimiters for a whole URL; 'form' is application/x-www-form-urlencoded (a space becomes '+', and on decode '+' becomes a space).

per_line.description: When true, convert each line of the input independently (rejoined with newlines) — for a batch list of values or URLs. Default false.

repeat.description: Apply the operation this many times, 1-16. Use >1 to un-nest multiply-encoded input when decoding (or to double-encode). Default 1.
